name: Discharge Train
description:
TANK-101's discharge train: the block valve, the drive, the pump motor and the flow loop, coordinated by SEQ-101 to establish and hold discharge flow. **A descriptor, not a strategy** — it names what belongs together and what the train's own numbers are; the modules it lists are what execute.

The motor is deliberately *not* an equipment module of its own. A single device with its own permissives, interlocks and timeouts is a control module; an equipment module exists to coordinate several of them through a phase, which is what this one does.

OPERATING_SPEED.description: VFD speed SEQ-101 ramps to. Lived as an unlabelled CONSTANT inside the sequence, where changing it meant opening a graph and knowing which constant was which.

RAMP_RATE.description: How fast the drive is brought up to speed.

OPEN_TIMEOUT.description: Longest wait for the XV-101 open limit switch before the sequence gives up on the step.

START_TIMEOUT.description: Longest wait for the motor run contact.

MIN_LEVEL.description: Below this the pump has no suction worth having; LI-101's LO limit is set here.
